# Descriptions
@@ 1
The caster can alter the visual appearance of an item, being, or place as
perceived in the mind of one target for the duration of this spell. The other
characteristics of the item, being, or place do not change. The nature of the
item, place, or being does not change (e.g., a book will remain a book, a
bridge will remain a bridge, etc.). The caster can set up to one conditional
action per level of the caster in the Overlay spell (this action requires no
concentration from the caster). The action is triggered on a given action by
the target with the item, being, or place that has been overlaid. By
concentrating, the caster can exercise dynamic control over what is perceived
in the target’s mind with regard to the affected item, being, or place (though
the target must still be within range of the caster). The caster may choose
one of the following options: a) an extra sense can be added to the Overlay
(the corresponding Seeming spell from the Seeming Enhancement spell list must
be known), b) an additional target may be affected, c) the duration can be
doubled, d) the range can be doubled, or e) an additional item, being, or
place may be altered.
@@ 2
The caster can create a visual (static or dynamic) image (e.g., of an item,
being, or place) which is perceived in the mind of one target for the duration
of this spell. The caster can set up to one conditional action per level of
the caster in the Seeming spell (this action requires no concentration from
the caster). This action is triggered on a given action by the target. By
concentrating, the caster can exercise dynamic control over what is perceived
in the target’s mind (though the target must still be within range of the
caster). The caster may choose one of the following options: a) an extra sense
can be added to the Seeming (the corresponding Seeming spell from Seeming
Enhancement spell list must be known), b) an additional target may be
affected, c) the duration can be doubled, d) the range can be doubled, or e)
an additional image (of an item, being or place) can be created.
@@ 3
As Overlay II, except the caster may choose two of the options.
@@ 4
As SeemingII, except any two of the options may be chosen.
@@ 5
As Overlay II, except it can be delayed up to 24 hours. At the time of
casting, the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The caster can
choose one of the following as a trigger for the spell: a) time period, b)
specified movement, c) specified sound, d) specified touch, e) specified
smell, f) specified taste, or g) other specified sensation perceived by the
target.
@@ 6
As Seeming II, except it can be delayed up to 24 hours. At the time of
casting, the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The caster can
choose one of the following as a trigger for the spell: a) time period, b)
specified movement, c) specified sound, d) specified touch, e) specified
smell, f) specified taste, or g) other specified sensation perceived by the
target.
@@ 7
As Overlay III, except four of the options may be chosen.
@@ 8
As Seeming II, except four of the options may be chosen.
@@ 9
As Waiting Overlay I, except the caster may choose two of the options.
@@ 10
As Waiting Seeming II, except two of the options can be chosen.
@@ 11
As Overlay III, except nine of the options may be chosen.
@@ 12
As Seeming II, except nine of the options may be chosen.
@@ 13
As Waiting Overlay III, except four of the options may be chosen.
@@ 14
As Waiting Seeming II, except four of the options can be chosen.
@@ 15
As Overlay III, except fourteen of the options may be chosen.
@@ 16
As Seeming II, except fourteen of the options may be chosen.
@@ 17
As Waiting Overlay III, except nine of the options may be chosen.
@@ 18
As Waiting Seeming II, except nine of the options can be chosen.
@@ 19
As Overlay III, except nineteen of the options may be chosen.
@@ 20
As Seeming II, except nineteen of the options may be chosen.
@@ 25
As Waiting Overlay III, except nineteen of the options may be chosen.
@@ 30
As Waiting Seeming II, except nineteen of the options can be chosen.
@@ 50
As either Overlay III or Seeming II except option per level of the caster may
be chosen.
